description: Large pothole approximately 30cm in diameter on Princess Street near City Hall. The hole is deep enough to damage vehicle tires and has been growing over the past week. It's in the right lane of traffic and poses a hazard, especially at night when it's hard to see.

description: Graffiti tags on the south wall of the Memorial Centre. Multiple spray paint markings covering approximately 10 square meters. The graffiti appeared over the weekend.

address: Division Street & Princess Street, Kingston, ON

description: Vehicle has been parked in the same spot on Queen Street for over 2 weeks. It appears abandoned - flat tires, covered in dirt. Taking up valuable parking space in the downtown core.
